analyze.title: Extract Design Styles
analyze.description: Enter a target URL to automatically extract the UI design system (colors, fonts, spacing, shadows, etc.)
analyze.emptyTitle: Enter a URL to start analyzing
analyze.emptyDescription: Supports any public webpage. To have AI revise an existing UI, export DESIGN.md first and provide the current screenshot or source code with it.
analyze.noAiHint: Basic extraction works without AI. For semantic enhancement (naming, design intent), configure an AI engine in Settings.
analyze.browserNotFound: Chrome or Edge browser not found. Please install one first.

aiExport.title: Use with AI Coding Agents

analyze.completeTip: Analysis complete! Copy DESIGN.md and give it to your AI coding agent.
analyze.invalidUrl: Please enter a valid URL (e.g. https://example.com)
analyze.noAiTip: No AI API Key or Agent CLI configured — analysis will still work, but token naming may be less descriptive. Configure in Settings.

pageCount.label: Pages to analyze
pageCount.help: Default: 3 (choose 1–5). Includes this URL and same-site pages; if fewer exist, only those are analyzed.

sessions.title: Website sign-ins
sessions.description: Used to access pages visible only after sign-in during analysis. View or remove website sign-ins saved by Imprint here.
sessions.notice: Signing in is not required: public and sign-in pages remain analyzable, but content available only after sign-in cannot be accessed. States stay in Imprint's isolated browser and never read or affect your everyday Chrome profile.
sessions.emptyDescription: A website appears here only after you choose to sign in during analysis and Imprint verifies it.
sessions.error: The saved sign-in could not be removed. Close any active sign-in browser and try again.

auth.requiredDescription: The target currently shows a sign-in page or blocking sign-in prompt. You can sign in with an isolated Imprint browser, or continue and analyze only the page that is currently visible.
auth.privacy: Imprint never reads your everyday Chrome profile. If you sign in, the session is saved only in a separate local browser profile for this website.
auth.loginWindowDescription: A separate Chrome window is open. Finish signing in there, then return to Imprint and continue.
auth.loginIncompleteTitle: Sign-in still appears to be required
auth.loginIncompleteDescription: The target page still shows a sign-in barrier. Finish the remaining steps in Chrome, then try continuing again.
auth.anonymousWarningDescription: This result only describes the sign-in page or prompt shown to signed-out visitors.

failure.title: Analysis stopped with an error
failure.description: The URL and any previous result have been kept. Review the actual error below, then retry when ready.

themes.title: Theme Library
themes.description: Browse, apply, or export built-in themes and themes extracted from websites.
themes.exportHelp: For AI revisions to an existing UI, export DESIGN.md first and include screenshots or source code. CSS variables and Tailwind are for direct implementation; Tokens JSON is for tools and automation. Built-in theme exports include reusable rules and tokens, but not Imprint-specific background images, textures, or shell styles.
themes.noExtractedTip: Go to the Analyze page to extract website design styles

default.name: Default
evidence: Semantic colors define hierarchy and state
Summaries precede token and export details

chinese-landscape.name: Ink Landscape
chinese-landscape.description: Xuan paper, five shades of ink, and a cinnabar accent
evidence: Paper texture stays behind content
Cinnabar is reserved for selection and key states
Serif headings, sans body, and monospaced code

cyberpunk.name: Cyberpunk
cyberpunk.description: A dark information deck with restrained cyan and amber signals
evidence: Shell, cards, and controls use distinct lightness levels
Emission is limited to focus and key actions
Cyan indicates action; amber indicates selection

nordic.name: Nordic Mist
nordic.description: Soft morning light with restrained natural warmth
evidence: Low-chroma fields divide working regions
Primary content stays on high-opacity surfaces
Warm color is reserved for small accents

glassmorphism.name: Aurora Glass
glassmorphism.description: Flowing color behind clear, floating layers
evidence: Blur is limited to the sidebar and top bar
Reading cards use near-solid surfaces
Aurora color remains behind the content plane

dunhuang.name: Dunhuang Mineral
dunhuang.description: Weathered plaster warmed by historic mineral pigments
evidence: Ochre and azurite mark only key states
Weathered texture does not cross reading surfaces
Historic material retains a modern information hierarchy

blueprint.name: Midnight Blueprint
blueprint.description: A precise coordinate grid for focused creation
evidence: The grid appears only on the working field
Monospaced type marks values and structure
Cyan indicates action; drafting yellow frames selection
